description: SQL-ACT-FAIL and SQL-CONTINUE, missing variant: the ADO lane (no dbFailOnError flag exists there). DAO creates Fu (unique K; 1,2,3,100), Fc (text S = '1','2','x','4', V Long), Fsrc/Fi (Req NOT NULL; Null at the third source row) and Fp/Fch (relationship; child on parent 3), then closes; an ADO connection (ACE OLE DB provider) with the recording sink on ConnectionEvents runs, each with RecordsAffected passed by reference as a typed VT_BYREF|VT_I4 preset to -1: UPDATE Fu SET K = IIf(ID = 3, 100, K + 10); UPDATE Fc SET V = CLng(S); INSERT INTO Fi SELECT ID, R FROM Fsrc ORDER BY ID; DELETE FROM Fp WHERE ID <= 3. Asks the HRESULT or ADO error, the written-back RecordsAffected, the ExecuteComplete event arguments and which rows survive (read by DAO afterwards). Follow-up probe (round 2) for SQL-ACT-FAIL, SQL-CONTINUE; works on a fresh writable copy of fixture r-q2-expr-sql-main. Each DAO statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
